accounts.name: Domain Name Wire
accounts.why: Highest-volume domain-industry news site (Andrew Allemann). Regular sale write-ups and links.

accounts.name: Andrew Allemann
accounts.why: Publisher of Domain Name Wire; personal account often quotes or discusses sales. Primary posting is also via DomainNameWire.

accounts.name: Domain Name Journal
accounts.why: Ron Jackson's DNJournal — weekly/monthly public sales charts, the industry's long-running sale ledger.

accounts.name: DomainSherpa
accounts.why: Interview / review show; guests and hosts discuss closed deals and appraisals.

accounts.name: Michael Cyger
accounts.why: DomainSherpa founder; still posts industry commentary and sale reactions (@MichaelCyger, also CygerSays).

accounts.name: Escrow.com
accounts.why: Official escrow for a large share of aftermarket domain transfers. Handle is Escrow_com (not Escrowcom).

accounts.name: GoDaddy Auctions
accounts.why: Official GoDaddy Auctions account; expired and public auction results (confirmed on GoDaddy blog).

accounts.name: NameBio
accounts.why: Public domain-sale database (Michael Sumner). Posts comps and sale commentary used as ground truth.

accounts.name: Afternic
accounts.why: GoDaddy aftermarket / BIN network. Occasional sale and inventory posts.

accounts.name: Sedo
accounts.why: Major aftermarket and brokerage; sale and auction announcements.

accounts.name: NameJet
accounts.why: Expired / backorder auction house; closing prices are often sale-like posts.

accounts.name: NamePros
accounts.why: Largest public domainer forum; account surfaces threads that include reported sales.

accounts.name: Elliot Silver / DomainInvesting.com
accounts.why: Long-running investor blog; frequent 'sold' / 'acquired' posts and deal commentary.

accounts.name: Morgan Linton
accounts.why: Domain investor/blogger; periodic sale and portfolio posts.

accounts.name: Shane Cultra
accounts.why: DSAD.com / former DomainShane; active seller, often posts closed names.

accounts.name: James Iles
accounts.why: Afternic / aftermarket product voice; discusses platform sales and tools.

accounts.why: Michael Cyger newsletter account; industry links including sale coverage.
